name: DiscoFuse: Discourse-Based Sentence Fusion Dataset
description: DiscoFuse is a large-scale dataset for discourse-based sentence fusion consisting of approximately 60.8 million sentence fusion examples. Generated by extracting discourse-connected sentence pairs from Wikipedia and sports articles, the dataset provides paired split and fused sentences annotated with discourse connectives and syntactic operations.

verification.notes: Verified against NAACL 2019 publication (DOI: 10.18653/v1/N19-1348) and official Google Research dataset deposit. Total of 60,819,766 sentence fusion examples across Wikipedia (16,642,323) and sports articles (44,177,443).
